audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart says "Skill" on all seven rows while the content layer and the packet levelChart both say Sylas/Diana/Sylas/Diana/Diana/Diana/Diana. The page renders two different answers to who wins each stage.
audit.why: Sylas at levels 1 and 3 has Chain Lash (Q, 10s rank 1) chip plus Kingslayer (W, 12s) healing it back, and at 3 he owns Abscond into Abduct; Diana only has one Pale Cascade shield (15s rank 1) to cover both. From 4-5 onward Diana's Q-mark into a cooldown-free Lunar Rush reset out-trades him.
audit.corrected: Align full phases[N].side to the content win[N] values and rewrite the whys on rows 0 and 2 to describe Sylas winning them.

audit.why: Spikes are level 3 (mark-dash pattern), level 6 Moonfall vs conditional Hijack (80/55/30s), first item, late reset chains. Hijack's rank-1 80s cooldown and its dependence on an enemy ultimate being available is the real spike asymmetry and the content layer already states it.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contains no number at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) and describes Abscond as a "chain-stun", which Riot's text does not say — Abscond is a dash, Abduct the recast pull.
audit.why: Abscond/Abduct is 13/12/11/10/9s, Kingslayer 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s and heals against champions, Hijack 80/55/30s, Diana's Pale Cascade 15/13.5/12/10.5/9s and Lunar Rush 22s at rank 1 but free onto a Moonlight-marked target. Those numbers are what make the step-up advice concrete.
audit.corrected: Rewrite breakdown.cooldowns with the real Abscond, Kingslayer, Pale Cascade and Hijack numbers, and fold in the Grievous Wounds requirement flagged by missingInteractions.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two copy-paste bleeds: dosFull[1].d is the tradeGood string verbatim and dontsFull[2].d is the tradeBad string verbatim, both under unrelated titles.
audit.why: The titles promise "Mark-dash his disengage windows" and "Chase resets through his wave"; the bodies explain something else entirely.
audit.corrected: Replace both bodies with content that matches the titles and is grounded in Abscond's 13s and Petricite Burst procs off his wave.

edits.before: Q the wave's edge and his face in one arc — the crescent farms and pokes at once; learn the curve's sweet spot.
edits.after: Chain Lash chips you twice per cast and Kingslayer heals it back — farm the arc's edge and skip the level 1 fight.

edits.before: E pull joins... no — your dash threat begins: Q-mark into E reset chases are live; trade on every landed crescent.
edits.after: Abscond (13s) plus Kingslayer (12s) is a full all-in at 3, and one Pale Cascade shield does not cover both halves.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - W Pale Cascade is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Abscond / Abduct is 13s at rank 1: once he dashes in, that window is yours to step up in. - Kingslayer is 12s and heals off you — buy Grievous Wounds before extended trades. - Pale Cascade is 15s at rank 1; no orbs, no trade. - Hijack is 80s at rank 1.

edits.before: Q through the wave onto his chest, E the mark, three-hit string, walk — the phase trade he answers after you've left.
edits.after: Abscond is his only exit at 13s — Q-mark him the moment he spends it, then E the mark and take the free three-hit string.

edits.before: Dashing onto an unmarked target with W down — Diana without the reset or the shield is a melee mage donating proximity.
edits.after: Chasing him past his minions feeds Petricite Burst free procs and lets Kingslayer heal off the wave while your E burns.

edits.before: Sylas wins by landing Abscond / Abduct, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Sylas wins by hitting Abduct off the wave, healing the trade back with Kingslayer, then casting your own Moonfall at you.

edits.before: Carry through the dive — mark, dash, pull, delete; your R turns their teamfight spacing into a suggestion.
edits.after: Carry by making Hijack worthless: R after he spends his steal, then mark, dash and delete him first in every fight.

notes: Chart: the full layer had all seven phases[N].side set to "Skill" while content win[N] and packet.levelChart agree on Sylas/Diana/Sylas/Diana/Diana/Diana/Diana. I moved the full layer onto the content values rather than the other way round, so NO paired win[N] edit exists — win[N] is already the correct value on every row and an edit whose before equals its after cannot be written. This is a chart-alignment group, not a verdict change; the two layers agree after it lands. Whys on rows 0 and 2 were rewritten in the same proposal so no row argues with itself. Anti-heal interaction from missingInteractions is now stated in breakdown.cooldowns (report[8] already mentioned it). Petricite Burst is a basic-attack chain proc, not a stun — the old cooldowns text called it a chain-stun and content whys[2] repeats that error ('lands Petricite Burst into sustain'); I left whys[2] alone because it is the content half of a chart row I did not move, and flagged it here instead.
